about.en: GROK is a community-run memecoin on Ethereum named after xAI's Grok chatbot, with no affiliation to xAI. It is an ERC-20 at 0x8390a1da07e376ef7add4be859ba74fb83aa02d5 with 9 decimals, launched in November 2023 and now maintained by a community takeover (CTO); CoinMarketCap lists it as "Grok (grokoneth.com)" to tell it apart from many unrelated GROK tokens.
